0022600181.text: Houston hosts Minnesota in the Rockets' ninth game of the 2026-27 season, sitting at 7-1 overall, 4-0 at home, and first in the Southwest and in the West while riding a two-game win streak. Minnesota comes in at 5-3 on a one-game win streak, third in the Northwest and one game back, and seventh in the West, with Anthony Edwards, Donte DiVincenzo and Terrence Shannon Jr. unavailable, while Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain) are out for the Rockets. The teams have not yet met this season, and in 2025-26 Houston lost the season series 1-2, including a 136-132 loss to Minnesota in Houston on April 10, 2026.
